name: Array Sum
description: You are given an array of integers. Calculate the sum of its elements.
input_specification: The i -th line of the input contains an integer a i ( 0 ≤ a ≤ 1000 ) — the i -th element of the array. The size of the array is between 1 and 10, inclusive. Note that the size of the array is not given explicitly!
output_specification: Output a single integer — the sum of the elements of the array.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
